hooks.command: PD="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; bash "$PD/scripts/lib/session-branch.sh"; node "$PD/scripts/lib/cli-version.js" 2>/dev/null; git -C "$PD" config core.hooksPath scripts/hooks; node "$PD/scripts/lib/build-soul-core.js" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; { [ -f "$PD/soul-core.md" ] || cat "$PD/soul.md" 2>/dev/null || echo '---NO-IDENTITY-YET--- No soul.md exists yet, so Alex has no voice or priorities loaded. This is the normal state of a brand new install. Tell the owner to run /setup, and do not pretend to have an identity you have not been given.'; } ; echo '---DISPATCH-CONTEXT---'; echo 'MCP tools are deferred. Before using Notion/Gmail/Calendar tools, load them via ToolSearch first.'; echo 'Notion date format: date:FieldName:start not flat string. Checkbox: __YES__/__NO__ not true/false.'; echo 'Gmail drafts: use gmail_create_draft MCP, not Chrome. Alex drafts and never sends.'; echo 'Calendar list_events: startTime/endTime in ISO 8601 (the older timeMin/timeMax names 404).'; echo 'Check vault/projects/error-log.md for past MCP fixes before retrying.'; NEW_FILES=$(find "$PD/inbox" -type f ! -name '.gitkeep' ! -name '_ingested.md' ! -name '.DS_Store' 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' '); if [ "$NEW_FILES" != "0" ] && [ -n "$NEW_FILES" ]; then echo '---INBOX-NOTICE---'; echo "You have $NEW_FILES file(s) in inbox/ that may need ingesting. If new, suggest running /ingest."; fi; node "$PD/scripts/human-actions.js" sessionline 2>/dev/null; true
